templates.purpose: Create an original niche design brief.
templates.prompt: Draft an original print-on-demand design brief for a non-branded niche. Include audience, product fit, phrase direction, visual style, color notes, and policy risks. Do not reference brands, celebrities, sports teams, lyrics, movies, games, anime, or protected characters.

templates.purpose: Review a phrase and visual direction before design.
templates.prompt: Review this merch concept for trademark, copyright, celebrity likeness, sports, brand confusion, sensitive content, and keyword stuffing risk. Return GREEN, YELLOW, or RED with required edits. Do not suggest bypass wording.

Draft a natural title, two bullets, short description, and keyword cluster for an original merch design. Keep copy neutral, non-infringing, and free from false quality, review, medical, or income claims.

Create manual social content drafts for a merch design. Include caption, short video hook, and save/share CTA. Do not imply fake engagement, customer impersonation, automated posting, or platform manipulation.
